title: Potential Impact of Microplastics and Nanoplastics on Human Health
what_it_is: Potential Impact of Microplastics and Nanoplastics on Human Health

sections.label: Microplastics health data and plastic waste
sections.summary: WHO and FAO reported in 2022 insufficient data on microplastics and nanoplastics health impact, while Singapore monitors studies and implements plastic waste reduction measures.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Sustainability and the Environment (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment)
sentences.text: The World Health Organization (WHO) and Food and Agriculture Organisation of the United Nations have indicated in their respective reports in 2022 that there is insufficient data to fully understand the impact of microplastics and nanoplastics on human health.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Sustainability and the Environment (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment)
sentences.text: Nonetheless, we are closely monitoring international discussions and scientific studies on this topic.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Sustainability and the Environment (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment)
sentences.text: Microplastics and nanoplastics can be produced from the breakdown of larger plastic debris.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Sustainability and the Environment (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment)
sentences.text: We have implemented measures to reduce plastic waste, as well as minimise the potential contribution of plastic debris into the environment and marine waters from land-based sources.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Sustainability and the Environment (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment)
sentences.text: These include robust waste management systems, a strict anti-littering enforcement regime and measures to encourage businesses and individuals to reduce the consumption of single-use plastics.

sections.label: Microplastics research and water surveillance
sections.summary: Evidence on microplastics health risk remains inconclusive, agencies work together, and PUB biennial surveillance since 2017 found no microplastics in treated water as of 2023.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: This issue has been the subject of various international studies and research, and as the Member has cited, this is one of the research that has been undertaken.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: But as I have noted, currently, based on the 2022 WHO report that I had cited earlier, the report has stated that the current global evidence on the impact of micro- and nanoplastics on health risk is still inconclusive and more data is needed to better understand the human exposure as well as then to characterise and quantify human health risks.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: Even studies, like what the Member has cited, also conclude that further research has to be done.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: So, indeed, MSE and MOH and various relevant agencies are working closely together, to better understand and monitor the impact of such environmental pollutants – microplastics and nanoplastics – on human health, and we will continue, as I have said, to track international studies and research in this area and we are open to considering support for relevant and useful research on this topic.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: But having said that, in the meantime, we will continue to look at how we can reduce plastic waste, as well as the amount of plastic debris that gets into the environment and marine waters, through our waste management systems, anti-littering enforcement regime, and getting businesses and individuals to also reduce plastic waste created.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: And as an assurance, let me also say that the Public Utilities Board, for instance, has been undertaking biennial surveillance of the presence of microplastics in water from our four National Taps since 2017.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: As of the latest test results in 2023, we have not detected any microplastics in the treated water and we will continue to monitor developments in this area.
